_comment: The single authored layer home — every enumerated gate resolves to exactly one layer here; nothing else declares layers.
Completeness is enforced, not defaulted: grader/roster.mjs throws on any enumerated gate this map does not cover.
checks holds the per-check layer; stages holds the per-stage default that a checks entry overrides.

F29.reason: bar position/height/colour are L1; the width band vs a piece is re-expressed in pointWidth (0.86 x point) by chunk B

F32.reason: off-tray presence/height/position are L1; the narrow band vs a piece is re-expressed in pointWidth by chunk B

F37.reason: scroll/height clauses are L1; the no-piece-past-edge clause is L2 but vacuous with zero pieces — deferred

F87.reason: mixes L1 board ratio/buttons with L2 pieces/ratio; NaN-fails with zero pieces — assigned the later layer
